content:
We release BFS-Prover-V2, a fully usable open-source step-level theorem prover for Lean 4 that scales both learning and search. It’s ready to run on your laptop out of the box, integrates with LLMLean, and allows interactive tactic generation inside Lean.

The system features two forms of scaling:
• Training-time scaling: multi-stage expert iteration with adaptive tactic-level filtering and periodic retraining, sustaining long-term improvement.
• Inference-time scaling: planner-enhanced multi-agent tree search for hierarchical reasoning and self-correction.

With the planner system, BFS-Prover-V2 reaches 95.08 % on miniF2F.
Using pure tree search, it achieves 41.4 % on ProofNet — both represent new state-of-the-art results for step-level provers.

Checkout out our Homepage, Paper, Code and Models!
